added_failures_note: The reviewed run armed no baseline_suite or after_suite: the brief declares light work with no test run, and its only measurement is gate_domain_labels.py, whose log records EXIT=0 at the base revision and whose negative control records EXIT=1. No suite delta exists, so no failure can be added or removed. As a head arm this review re-ran that same gate script at the landed head, on the sheet plus the two committed label files extracted from a0462193f, and it printed entries=113 distinct_ids=113 ids_match_sheet_order=True bad_domains=0 bad_second_choices=0 with EXIT=0, so the head arm fails no test either.

findings.text: non-blocking: the notes state that anything on a divertor target structure, including nuclear heating, belongs to divertor_physics, but item-095 at labels-second-reader.json:661 labels nuclear_heating_power_of_divertor as neutronics, so the documented rule and the applied labels disagree and a reader comparing the two readers cannot tell which rule was used.

non-blocking: the notes file is 331 words (320 excluding the title) against the brief's under-300 limit, and the run manifest states the file is under 300 words, so the record overstates a constraint the gate never measures.

non-blocking: the only guard over the delivered labels lives in the run directory and not in the repository, so any later edit to labels-second-reader.json — including one made when the two readers are compared — is unchecked; the node's write scope forbade adding an in-repo test, so this is recorded rather than repaired here.

item_verdicts.call_sites: none — the two files are evidence data under docs/evidence/fragments/; the only repository references to labels-second-reader.json are in second-reader-brief.md, which is a brief and not runtime code.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 55fb002df; one commit a0462193f adds two new files, 839 lines, with a conventional subject and a body stating the quantity judged and the independence rule; no test, source or plan file is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for exactly one entry per one of the 113 ids with every domain a key of the sheet's domains and the file parsing; gate_domain_labels.py asserts entries==113, distinct==113, ids in sheet order, zero bad domains, zero bad second choices, confidence in set and no missing reason, and its log records those figures with EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is one independent physics-domain label per blind-sheet item; the landed labels-second-reader.json carries 113 entries, one domain key each, in sheet order, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, the gate log path, the red negative-control log at EXIT=1, the full list of files opened, and a rubric line per dimension, and its stated counts (113 entries, high 60 / medium 52 / low 1, 53 second choices, 25 domains) all reproduce against the committed file.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the declared paths from the review dispatch and the source manifest; git show --stat a0462193f lists only docs/evidence/fragments/sn-domain-family-labels/labels-second-reader.json and labels-second-reader-notes.md, both inside the declared pair.

justifications.durability: gate_domain_labels.py:26-34 compares each label against the sheet's own domain keys and id order rather than against a value the gate supplied, so a drifted domain or a dropped id reddens it; the guard nonetheless lives only in the run directory, so nothing in the repository re-checks the file.
justifications.evidence: gate-domain-labels.log records entries=113 distinct_ids=113 ids_match_sheet_order=True bad_domains=0 with EXIT=0, and gate-negative-control.log records bad_domains=1 bad_second_choices=1 GATE=FAIL EXIT=1, so the gate measures the done_when and is shown to fire.
justifications.fit: labels-second-reader.json:1 follows the list-of-entries shape of its sibling reader artefact and labels-second-reader-notes.md:1 records rules in the same prose style as labels-notes.md, with no plan, stage, version or ticket identifier in either name or content.
justifications.goal_fidelity: labels-second-reader.json:1-793 labels all 113 sheet ids with a sheet domain key, but item-095 at labels-second-reader.json:661 carries neutronics where labels-second-reader-notes.md:17 states nuclear heating on a divertor goes to divertor_physics.
justifications.reuse: No code was added; a capability search for a labels-comparison owner found only the unrelated study scripts under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/, which this change neither extends nor duplicates.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat a0462193f touches only the two declared fragment paths; the generator, gate and landing record live in the run directory and scratch, not in the repository.

notes: Counts in the run manifest were re-derived from the committed file rather than taken on trust: 113 entries, 113 distinct ids, sheet order preserved, confidence high 60 / medium 52 / low 1, 53 second choices, 25 of 32 domains used, general unused — all reproduce. The first reader's labels.json and labels-notes.md were not opened, so the two readings were not compared here; that comparison is the use of this artefact, not a step in reviewing it.
